name: Machining Cell
description:
Two job routes compete for shared operators.

Is the limiting factor the slower machine or the operator pool?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of fixed job releases; jobs take one of two machining routes.
• Each occupied machine holds one operator throughout its service.
• Equipment is illustrative sourced metalworking artwork; toolpaths, changeovers and CNC control are not modeled.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
